title: identity.user.created.v1
description: Zitadel created a human user, and identity received it through the Zitadel Action webhook (M2 spec #28). CloudEvents subject: the user sub. Both ids are Zitadel ids, as in the access token: identity has no own org id until #29 maps Zitadel orgs to org rows. The orgid extension stays unset for the same reason. No email, no personal name.

user_sub.description: Subject id (token sub) of the new user. Never an email.

zitadel_org_id.description: Zitadel org the user belongs to (token claim urn:zitadel:iam:user:resourceowner:id).
